_meta.description: A receipt or invoice draft made on the phone carries the client id the phone gave it, unique per schema, so a queued item sent twice is found again instead of stored twice (REQ-PMP-003). Receipt's version moves here (0.1.0 -> 0.2.0); ARInvoice's moves in zz-financial-documents-linked-objects.json (0.17.0 -> 0.18.0), the fragment that keeps the last word on that schema's version.

clientId.title: Client id
clientId.description: The id the mobile app gave this receipt when it was captured, also offline. A second sync of the same receipt finds it by this id. Empty on a receipt made on the desktop.

clientId.title: Client id
clientId.description: The id the mobile app gave this invoice draft when it was made, also offline. A second sync of the same draft finds it by this id. Empty on an invoice made on the desktop.
